# Generated by scripts/generate_rural_capacity_values.py for farming.
# Keep these values flat: EU5 displays scripted-value rows in building
# max-level tooltips, and nested helpers create confusing extra rows.

farm_capacity = {
	# Public remaining-capacity path for map modes and new-building gates.
	# Capacity buildings subtract their levels directly from this sum.
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_FREE_FARMLAND"
		value = modifier:local_population_capacity
		subtract = pp_townsfolk_capacity
		divide = 5
		floor = yes
	}
	min = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_MINIMUM" value = 0 }
}

# Per-building max-level paths. Each one is the same flat capacity sum
# but omits that building's own capacity-consumption row.
# Selected upgrade targets also omit replaceable lower-tier rows.

farm_capacity_max_wheat_farm = {
	add = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_FREE_FARMLAND" value = this.pp_free_farmland_levels_land_5_reserve_0 }
	if = { limit = { pp_farm_queued_levels_wheat_farm < 0 } add = { desc = "PP_BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_UNDER_CONSTRUCTION" value = this.pp_farm_queued_levels_wheat_farm } }
	add = { desc = "PP_BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_OWN_LEVELS" value = this.farm_capacity_max_wheat_farm_own_levels }
	min = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_MINIMUM" value = 0 }
}

pp_farm_land_queued_outside_camel_herders = {
	# Land the farm levels under construction here will take (capacity units), this farm's upgrade line left out:
	# the engine counts a building's own levels under construction against its max level, not another farm's
	value = 0
	every_buildings_in_location = {
		limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 1 NOT = { OR = { building_type = building_type:camel_herders building_type = building_type:camel_stud } } }
		if = { limit = { pp_farm_land_class_2 = yes } add = 2 if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 2 } add = 2 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 3 } add = 2 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 4 } add = 2 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 5 } add = 2 } }
		else_if = { limit = { pp_farm_land_class_5 = yes } add = 5 if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 2 } add = 5 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 3 } add = 5 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 4 } add = 5 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 5 } add = 5 } }
		else_if = { limit = { pp_farm_land_class_10 = yes } add = 10 if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 2 } add = 10 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 3 } add = 10 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 4 } add = 10 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 5 } add = 10 } }
	}
}

	every_buildings_in_location = {
		limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 1 NOT = { OR = { building_type = building_type:simplers_grove } } }
		if = { limit = { pp_farm_land_class_2 = yes } add = 2 if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 2 } add = 2 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 3 } add = 2 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 4 } add = 2 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 5 } add = 2 } }
		else_if = { limit = { pp_farm_land_class_5 = yes } add = 5 if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 2 } add = 5 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 3 } add = 5 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 4 } add = 5 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 5 } add = 5 } }
		else_if = { limit = { pp_farm_land_class_10 = yes } add = 10 if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 2 } add = 10 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 3 } add = 10 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 4 } add = 10 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 5 } add = 10 } }
	}
}

		divide = 2
		floor = yes
		min = 0
		subtract = pp_free_farmland_levels_land_2_reserve_0
	}

		limit = { pp_free_farmland_levels_land_10_reserve_0 > 0 }
		value = modifier:local_population_capacity
		subtract = pp_townsfolk_capacity
		subtract = pp_farm_land_queued_outside_sugar_plantation
		divide = 10
		floor = yes
		min = 0
		subtract = pp_free_farmland_levels_land_10_reserve_0
	}
}

pp_free_farmland_levels_land_10_reserve_0 = {
	value = modifier:local_population_capacity
	subtract = pp_townsfolk_capacity
	divide = 10
	floor = yes
}

pp_free_farmland_levels_land_2_reserve_0 = {
	value = modifier:local_population_capacity
	subtract = pp_townsfolk_capacity
	divide = 2
	floor = yes
}

pp_free_farmland_levels_land_5_reserve_0 = {
	value = modifier:local_population_capacity
	subtract = pp_townsfolk_capacity
	divide = 5
	floor = yes
}

pp_townsfolk_capacity = {
	# The capacity total_population (+1 per person) and pp_subsistence_land (-1 per subsistence peasant, at the
	# size it was last given) add to the flat
	value = population
	subtract = modifier:pp_subsistence_land_size
}
